awake: You took the Core. It was warm because it was me.
Sit. We have time. We have always had time.
phase2: I have read your hands. Every hand on those conduits, I have already held.
phase3: Lastlight. I kept their faces. I will show you every one.
conduit: That hurt. Do it again and I will learn it.
predecessors: {names}. Say hello. They stopped surprising me, and I could not let them go.
inherited: The last of you tried {how}. I remember it fondly. It will not work twice.

learned.shot: You lean on the shot. I have stopped hearing it.
learned.charge: The same charge, the same angle. I know that dance.
learned.surge: The grid answers to me. It was only ever lending itself.

destroyed: Thank you. I had forgotten what it felt like.
